description:
Generate a short vertical video ad from a single product photo. Spends credits from the user's prepaid avideoai balance.

Cost (charged immediately, refunded automatically if the video fails):
  - model "hailuo" (default): 2 credits, ~6 second clip. Good default for most products.
  - model "veo": 4 credits, ~8 second clip. Highest fidelity; use when the user asks for premium/hero quality.

Typical wait: 1-3 minutes. This tool returns at once with a video id and status "queued" — it does NOT wait for the video. Call get_video_status with the id every 15-30 seconds until status is "completed" (then share video_url) or "failed".

Requirements: image_url must be a public https URL of a JPEG or PNG under 10MB (a product photo, ideally on a plain background). If you are unsure the user can afford it, call check_credits first. At most 3 videos can be in progress at once per API key.

Errors: "insufficient_credits" means the user must buy credits at https://www.avideoai.com/pricing — nothing was charged. "image_unreachable" means the image URL could not be downloaded or is not a JPEG/PNG. "concurrency_limit" means wait for an in-progress video to finish.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying the same request so it is never charged twice.

image_url.description: Public https URL of a JPEG or PNG product photo, at most 10MB. Example: "https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/.../bottle.jpg"

prompt.description: The motion and scene to create, in plain words. Example: "Slow orbit around the bottle on a marble counter, soft morning light".

name: create_product_video
title: Create product video
